# stalwart_alert (Data Source)

Defines an alert rule triggered by metric conditions. Requires an Enterprise license.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `condition` (Attributes) The condition that triggers the alert. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition))
- `email_alert` (Attributes) Email notification settings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_alert))
- `enable` (Boolean) Enable or disable the alert
- `event_alert` (Attributes) Event notification settings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event_alert))

<a id="nestedatt--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `condition`

Read-Only:

- `else` (String) Else condition
- `match` (Attributes List) List of conditions and their corresponding results (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition--match))

### Nested Schema for `condition.match`

Read-Only:

- `if` (String) If condition
- `then` (String) Then clause



<a id="nestedatt--email_alert"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_alert`

Read-Only:

- `body` (String) The body of the email
- `from_address` (String) The email address of the sender
- `from_name` (String) The name of the sender
- `subject` (String) The subject of the email
- `to` (Set of String) The email address of the recipient(s)
